definition: Of, relating to, or occurring in summer; having the character of summer.
etymology: From Latin aestivalis, itself from aestas meaning summer, which shares an ancient Indo-European root with the Greek word for burning or blazing. The Romans used aestivare to mean spending the summer somewhere, the warm-weather mirror of hibernare.
usage: The estival light at seven in the evening, still gold and unhurried, made it impossible to go back indoors.
